Commentary.Commentary: Hmmm... Group of Death strikes! England have been defeated by South Africa. This group is so close that as Heather Knight pointed out, one loss could make every game a knockout. Monday is back to Group A, which sees a double header. Bruised Australia take on a confident Sri Lanka while the India-Bangladesh match follows after that. The action starts at 3 pm local (0700 GMT). Join us on 24th February, 2020. ADIOS! TAKE CARE!

Victorious South African skipper, Dane van Niekerk says that she is not a great watcher when the game goes that tense but says that her heartbeat is normal now. On fielding in this game, Dane says that in New Zealand, in their previous series, it was very ordinary and they realized that it is one department which needs to improve. Is proud that the plans and tactics came out beautifully here. Stresses that it is one thing to plan but another to execute it. Praises the fast bowlers for stepping up and setting the tone. Feels proud to be able to play against a quality side like England and wishes them all the best for the upcoming games. Is filled with more pride in being a part of du Preez' 100th game and believes that no one deserves more. Just wants to make every South African fan proud back home.

England captain, Heather Knight, feels that they started well with the bat but the middle overs cost them, where they faced quite a lot of dot balls. Reckons that they finished well, praising the cameos. Believes that it was a good score on that wicket. Is really pleased to have Natalie Sciver back in the squad, taking responsibility of the batting and bowling line-ups. On thoughts about defending the total at the halfway stage, Knight says they had to believe they could win and the bowlers bowled outstandingly but perhaps the runs scored were not enough. On their next game being in Canberra, Heather hopes that it brings in a change in luck as every game now becomes a must-win for them.

DANE VAN NIEKERK has been named the Player Of The Match. Says that she was nervous coming up against England as she regards them as very good players of spin. Credits all the other bowlers for the support and puts it as a team performance. On the WACA pitch for a spinner, Dane says that she does not depend on bounce and only tries to be accurate and restrict runs as much as possible. On the batting, she says that she just tried to hang in there and take the game as deep as possible.

Mignon du Preez becomes the first South African woman to feature in 100 T20Is, so she is called for a chat. Says that there was too much pressure and she was nervous but is feeling lucky that she could take her team home. Regards this as a special win as they have never reached too far in a World Cup.

Cannot really blame a bowling unit if it is defending 'just' 123 but even that was made look like defendable. Every bowler was economical, not giving much away but the last 3 overs made England wilt under pressure. And South Africa capitalized. Sophie Ecclestone was the pick of the bowlers with 2/19 in 4 overs.

South Africa were well placed at 90/1, needing 34 from 28 balls but then, they lost both set batsmen in the span of 5 balls, without a run being added. Pressure. Tremors. 34 still needed, but the balls remaining gone down to 23 now. That is where England exhibited signs of a brilliant comeback, bowling excellently at the death - but Tryon and du Preez just about woke up in time to get some boundaries and take the team over the line.

The Women In Green approached the game with good planning. They lost Lizelle Lee early but the partnership of 84 between Marizanne Kapp and skipper Dane van Niekerk set up a platform for the win. They started confidently and stayed abreast with the running rate. But can there be any game involving South Africa which does not have a choke? So, then came one along.

It all started with the ball. Is this really Australia where the tournament is being held? We have seen 4 matches now and in every game, the pitches have been dead slow. England struggled to get going with the bat and limped to 123, that too, thanks largely to Natalie Sciver's 50. That set the platform for a South African win because the required rate was just over 6.

Game 1 sees a shocker. Game 4 too, sees a shocker. On Friday, the defending champions and the favourites get stunned. On Sunday, their arch rivals, the 2018 finalists and the second favourites for the tournament are shocked! Well done, South Africa. England were the favourites entering this game but their counterparts have displayed better nerves.
FOUR! SA WIN BY 6 WICKETS! A full toss, on middle, de Preez pulls it over mid-wicket! The South African dugout is all smiles!
SIX! Whoa! Mignon, you beauty! What a shot under pressure. With 7 needed from 4 balls, Brunt bowls a slower one on middle. Du Preez spots it and slogs it over mid-wicket! The scores are level!
Outside off, pushed through point for a run.
Full and down the leg side, du Preez looks to swing but gets a thick inside edge onto the pads. The ball rolls towards point and a single is taken.
OUT! BOWLED! More drama. Full and straight, Tryon swings hard, only to miss. The stumps are shattered! 9 needed from the final over. Sune Luus is the new batter in.

STUMPING CHANCE MISSED! Nerves, nerves. First, Tryon comes down the track and seeing that the bowler slows down the pace. The batter swings but misses. An easy stumping is on offer but Amy Jones misses it! Fumbles the ball.
SIX! That is an amazing shot. Full and outside off, Tyron gets down and slog sweeps it over backward square leg!
Du Preez comes down the track and pushes it to long on for a single.
Full and outside off, Tyron comes down the track and drags this off a top edge towards deep mid-wicket. Du Preez was back for the second but Tyron was not in the mood for it.

NOT OUT! Missing the leg stump. Full delivery down the leg side, Tryon looks to flick but misses. She gets hit on the pads and the England players appeal. The umpire does not agree. They take the review. The Ultra Edge rolls in and it shows that there is no bat on it. The Ball Tracker then shows that it is missing the leg stump. Waste of a review. The fielder throws it to the bowler's end but misses. The ball goes towards the mid off region allowing the batters to take a couple.
An appeal for LBW has been taken upstairs. Chloe Tryon is the batter in question. It looks like it miss the stumps. Let's see what transpires.
Full on middle, du Preez heaves it away towards the square leg region and picks up a couple. Good over for South Africa.
Just short! Shortish in length on middle, du Preez pulls it but does not time it well. Winfield comes ahead but the ball falls short. A couple taken.
Full toss on middle, Tryon pushes it down to long on for a single.
TOP EDGE AND FOUR! Short ball on off, Tryon looks to pull but takes the top edge and goes over the short fine leg fielder for a boundary.
Short ball on middle, du Preez looks to pull but it takes the top edge and land short of the deep square leg region. A single.
FOUR BYES! Good length ball on the pads, du Preez looks to heave it away but misses. The keeper fails to collect it and the ball races to the fence.
Natalie Sciver is back on. 3-0-17-0 are her figures so far.
Floated around off, it is pushed towards the off side. Another excellent over for England. They are pulling things back really well. 33 needed in the last 3 overs.
Full and around off, Tryon skip down the track and looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. There is a mild appeal but not out says the umpire.
Loopy ball around off, de Preez pushes it towards mid of for a run.
Full and outside off, de Preeze firmly sweeps it but finds short fine leg.
Floated around off, it is defended.
Mignon du Preez is in now!

OUT! CAUGHT! Yes, she can! Both the set batters depart now. Short and outside off, Van Niekerk looks to cut but ends up doing it straight to Beaumont who lunges forward and pouches it well. This is a huge, huge wicket. Two new batters in the crease now. An excellent hand from the South African skipper comes to an end.
Bowling change! Sophie Ecclestone is back on! Can she strike too?
Loopy ball around off, Tryon pushes it back to the bowler. Excellent over comes to an end.
Fuller and just outside off, Tryon drives it firmly but straight to the cover fielder.
Flatter and just outside off, pushed towards point.
Chloe Tryon walks in next. She can use the long handle well.

OUT! CAUGHT AND BOWLED! Glenn provides the breakthrough. Heather Knight is pumped. Bowls it slower through the air and lands it full on middle, Kapp looks to drive but ends up chipping it back to the bowler. A straightforward catch for Glenn, she is not going to miss out.
Short ball on middle, Dane pulls it to the deep mid-wicket region for a single.
FOUR! Flighted ball outside off, Van Niekerk lifts it towards the extra cover region for a boundary.
On the pads, worked behind square leg for a run. 11 from the over, an excellent over for South Africa.
SIX! There's the release shot from the captain. Length ball around off, Van Niekerk moves inside the crease and slams it over the deep square for a biggie.
Landed around off on a length, Kapp works it behind square leg for a run.

In the air... but safe! Short ball around middle, Van Niekerk goes to heave it over deep mid-wicket but mistimes it. It balloons high in the air but lands well in front of charging deep mid-wicket fielder. A run taken.
Length ball around off, this time Kapp strokes it to long on for a run.
Shortish and around middle, pushed towards mid-wicket for a run.
Anya Shrubsole is back on. 3-0-15-1 are her figures so far.
Misfield and a run! Length ball around off, Van Niekerk pushes it back to the bowler but Sciver is late in getting down and ends up giving a run.
Full and around off, pushed to covers.
Full ball around off and middle, it is stroked to long on for a run.
Good length ball on middle, Van Niekerk flicks it to deep square leg for  a single.
Well fielded! Short ball on middle, Kapp pulls it to deep square leg where the fielder comes across and makes a good diving stop. Only a single.
Good length ball on middle, Kapp drives it to mid on.
Natalie Sciver returns. 2-0-13-0 are her numbers so far.
On middle, driven to long on for a single.
Full delivery on the pads, Van Niekerk works it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Length ball on middle, Dane flicks it to mid-wicket.
Short ball on off, Kapp pulls it to deep mid-wicket for a single.
Short delivery outside off, Van Niekerk comes down the pitch and punches it to cover for a single.
Good length ball on the pads, Van Niekerk looks to flick but it goes onto hit the pads.
Katherine Brunt is back on. 2-0-7-0 so far.
Loopy one on middle, Kapp sweeps it to the deep square leg region for a single.
A flat delivery on the pads, Kapp flicks it to the leg side for a single.
Full delivery on middle, Dane drives it to long on and crosses over for a single.
Full on off, Van Niekerk pushes it to cover.
Floated on middle, driven to long on for a single.
FOUR! With the fielders up, there was always a boundary for the taking! Short ball outside off, Kapp cuts it through the backward point region for a boundary.
Full delivery on the pads, Kapp flicks it to the deep mid-wicket region for a single.
Tossed up ball on off, Kapp defends it to the cover region.
On off, pushed to point.
Flatter one on middle, Dane flicks it to the leg side for a single.
Loopy one on off, Kapp drives it to long off for a single. 50-run stand is up. The duo need to continue the good work and take the side home.
Flighted ball on middle, Van Niekerk sweeps it to deep square leg for a single.
Sophie Ecclestone is back on! 1-0-6-0 from her.
FOUR! Excellent finish to the over! Short and just outside off, Kapp slaps it towards cover-point where Brunt dives over the ball and it races away to the fence. 70 more needed in the final 10 overs.
Short and on middle, it is pulled to deep mid-wicket for a run by Van Niekerk. 50 up for South Africa.
On off, it is defended.
Flatter one on middle, Kapp works it towards long for a run.
Full and on off, this time she strokes it to long on for an easy run.
Full and around off, Van Niekerk finds mid off to her drive.
Length ball angled into the batter, Van Niekerk works it towards square leg with soft hands and takes a run.
Landed on middle on a length, Kapp works it towards mid-wicket and takes a run as the keeper chases it down.
On the pads on a length, Van Niekerk tucks it fine down the leg side for a run.
WIDE! Called for height as Sciver bangs this one on a back of a length and outside off, Van Niekerk lets it be as it is beyond her reach. Wided by the square leg umpire.
On middle, it is worked towards the leg side.
Bouncer on middle, Kapp goes for the pull but mistimes it behind square on the leg side. A run taken.
FOUR! Excellent batting. She knows where the fielders are. Sciver bowls a fuller ball around off and middle, Kapp launches it over mid on to bag a boundary.
Natalie Sciver is back into the attack! 1-0-4-0 are her figures so far.
Shortish and around middle, Van Niekerk pulls it towards deep mid-wicket for a couple of runs.
On the stumps line, tucked behind square leg for a run.
Floated on off, Kapp comes forward and defends it out.
On middle, flicked to deep mid-wicket for a run.
A couple now! Full and around off, Van Niekerk lofts it over extra cover and scampers back for the second before the long off fielder can cut it off.
Shortish and around middle, pushed back to the bowler.
Bowling change! Sarah Glenn into the attack.
Bowls it full and around off, worked towards mid-wicket. 26/1 after the Powerplay! Need more 98 runs.
FOUR! Deft from Kapp now! Quicker, shorter one, it is just outside off. Kapp waits for the ball and at the last moment runs it down to the third man fence.
Full and on middle, Kapp finds mid-wicket.
Quicker one on the pads, worked to deep mid-wicket for a run by Van Niekerk.
WIDE! Drifts down the leg side. Van Niekerk tries flicking but misses. Wided.
Flatter and around off, Van Niekerk pushes it back to the bowler.
Floated full ball around off, pushed to covers.
Sophie Ecclestone to bowl now.
FOUR! Nailed it! That was timed brilliantly. Short and outside off, Kapp rides the bounce and punches it with hard hands. She finds the gap and the ball races away to the deep point fence.
On the pads this time, Van Niekerk tucks it towards fine leg for a run.
Another short ball, this is outside off, Van Niekerk fends it towards point.
Shortish and around middle, Van Niekerk hops and keeps it out.
Length ball on off, Dane comes down the track and defends it to mid off.
Fullish on middle, Van Niekerk pushes it to mid on for a dot.
Katherine Brunt is back on. 1-0-2-0 from her so far.
Length ball on off, Kapp pushes it to mid off.
Good length ball on middle, Dane flicks it to the deep square leg region for a single.
FOUR! Swept away nicely! Fullish on off, Van Niekerk moves to the off side and sweeps it to the deep mid-wicket region for a boundary.
On off, pushed to point.
Good length ball on middle, Van Niekerk defends it out.

SIX! CLOBBERED! This is one heck of a shot! What a strike from the South African captain. This is should release some pressure. A length ball angled into the batter, Van Niekerk picks it early and launches it over wide long on for a massive six.

DROPPED AND FOUR! Difficult chance though! Full on middle, Kapp looks to go over long on but does not time it well. Winfield runs behind but gets only fingertips on it. The ball races to the long on fence. Off the mark off the 6th ball.
Length ball on off, Kapp defends it to cover.
Full on middle, Kapp pushes it to mid on.
On a length on off, Kapp blocks it back to the bowler.
Length ball on off, Kapp plays it to the off side.
Good length ball on middle, Kapp defends it back to the bowler.
Natalie Sciver is on now.
Good length ball outside off, Van Niekerk leaves the ball alone. Only 1 run and a wicket from it.
Full on middle, Van Niekerk defends it back to the bowler.
Good length ball on off, Van Niekerk punches it to cover.
Marizanne Kapp is in at 3.

OUT! CAUGHT! Just the start that England needed. They are delighted and why wouldn't they be! Full delivery on off, Lee looks to go over mid on but does not the timing that she wanted. Winfield stationed at mid on takes the simplest of catches and Lee has to make the long walk back to the pavilion.
On a length on off, Lee punches it to point.
Top edge but safe! Good length ball on off, Van Niekerk looks to heave it away with her eyes closed but it takes the top edge and goes towards third man. A single.
An appeal for LBW turned down! Full delivery on the pads, Lee looks to flick but misses to get hit on the pads. An appeal is made but the umpire shakes his head.
BEATEN! Nicely bowled! Good length ball outside off, Lee looks to defend but fails to get any bat on it.
Good length ball on off, Van Niekerk guides it to third man for a single.
Poor delivery but gets away with it! Full delivery down the leg side, Lee flicks it but there is a fine leg in place. Only a single in the end.
On a length on off, Lee drives it straight to mid off.
Swing straightaway! Brunt starts with a full delivery on off, swinging away, Lee looks to drive but it takes the outside edge and goes towards the point region.
Katherine Brunt will bowl from the other end. 1 slip in place for her.
Fullish on off, Dane drives it to cover. Good start for England. Only 3 runs from the first over.
Good length on off, Van Niekerk blocks it to the cover region.
Fullish delivery on off, Van Niekerk prods forward and defends it to the cover region.
Full on middle, Lee looks to flick but it takes the inside edge and goes towards deep square leg. A single.
Lucky! Full delivery on off, Lee looks to lift it over long on but fails to time it well. Luckily for her, it lands over the mid on fielder and the batters pick up a couple.
Shrubsole starts with a length ball on middle, Lee defends it back to the bowler.

The run chase is all set to get underway! England players make their way out to the middle in defense of 123. Dane Van Niekerk and Lizelle Lee follow them out. Anya Shrubsole will start with the ball.
